name: @mailwoman/sentencepiece-wasm
description: google/sentencepiece v0.2.2 compiled to WASM with a native-offsets binding — the rollback tokenizer runtime for @mailwoman/neural, which runs on @mailwoman/mtf. An ESM loader with the wasm beside it, no runtime deps; per-piece byte offsets come from SentencePiece itself instead of TS-side reconstruction.
